mapper.select: SELECT match_no, plab_match_no, stadium_name, stadium_no, match_dt, match_tm, current_player_cnt, sub_type FROM plab_match WHERE STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(match_dt, match_tm), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') >= NOW() ORDER BY match_dt ASC, match_tm ASC

SELECT s.subscription_no, m.plab_match_no, s.member_no, s.email,
m.stadium_name, m.match_dt, m.match_tm,
s.noti_type, s.noti_value, m.current_player_cnt, m.sub_type as currentSubType FROM match_subscription s JOIN plab_match m ON s.plab_match_no = m.plab_match_no WHERE
( s.plab_match_no = #{e.plabMatchNo} AND s.noti_type = #{e.notiType} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO noti_history ( subscription_no, member_no, email, noti_type, noti_setting, send_dt, send_tm ) VALUES ( #{subscriptionNo}, #{memberNo}, #{email}, #{notiType}, #{notiValue}, #{sendDt}, #{sendTm} )
